notes: Deploy PlantOrganism on Robinhood Chain (4663). Constructor arguments are IMD, Intake, action, oracle signer, FALLBACK_CELL and deployer, in that order. The action is bytes32("oracle.request@oracle-1"), right-padded with zeros; fallback cell 10223579 is Lisbon (38.875, -9.125). $owner receives the sole deployer privilege: one bind(hook) call after the separate PLANT token and hook launch. Binding requires hook.organism() to equal this organism and records hook.plant(); the deployer has no powers afterward. This manifest deploys only PlantOrganism, with no token, pool, hook, ETH funding or initialization calls. The application has no admin, upgrade or pause. Oracle signer, Intake and action rotation requires authorization from the current oracle signer. See README.md for keeper operation, fee advance accounting and token assumptions.
